name: uk-il-toolkit
description: The UK Industrial & Logistics toolkit for Claude. Build a client-ready I&L longlist from a Kato requirement — enriched with rents and specs from the broker emails, ending in a per-property dataset, a clean client Excel and a CBRE-branded HTML dashboard — and download every brochure PDF linked from a longlist spreadsheet as one clean zip, named after each property and validated. Versioned and installed independently of the CBRE I&L Toolkit, so updating one never re-syncs the other.
